configuration.text:
nice_constellation = "ruby"
supports_selftracked_controller = true

[ocal]
# The latency maximum applied while waiting for assembling a
# heterogeneous frame set for Online Calibration.
assemble_wait_ms = 20
# If the difference of the capture timestamp between the RGB
# frame set and the monochrome frame set is within this tolerance,
# both frame sets will be assembled into a hetorogeneous frame set.
assemble_tolerance_us = 1000 # us

[perf]
# Also hints wake the CtrlTracking thread wakes as the same core as
# SBEventHandler and IOTmotion threads
wake_affine_controller = true
# Enables dev cores
use_obj_track_cpuset = true
